description: View project releases and asset download links. Actions: list (releases sorted by date), get (release details by tag name), assets (download link list for release). Related: manage_release to create/publish.

action.description: Action to perform: list, get, assets

include_html_description.description: Include HTML-rendered description in response Required for 'list', 'get' action(s).

order_by.description: Sort releases by field (default: released_at) Required for 'list' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (max 100) Required for 'list', 'assets' action(s).

sort.description: Sort direction (default: desc) Required for 'list' action(s).

tag_name.description: The Git tag associated with the release (e.g., 'v1.0.0') Required for 'get', 'assets' action(s).

name: browse_releases
